originality.rationale: Verified against full text where obtainable. 1302.5742 (Boij-Migliore-Miro-Roig-Nagel-Zanello): the paper's open case is H=(1,3,6,6,3,1); its Lemma 3.7 proves every CI with H=(1,3,5,5,3,1) has WLP except char 3 with I=(x^2,y^3,z^3), and Theorem 3.8 gives the (1,3,6,6,3,1) char-3 exception I=(x^2y,x^2z,y^3,z^3,x^4+y^2z^2). Neither constructs a non-CI Pfaffian ideal at (1,3,5,5,3,1) over F3 nor any Betti/Jordan comparison. 2203.01258 (Abdallah-Altafi-Iarrobino-Seceleanu-Yameogo): proves SLP for Sperner<=6 only in characteristic zero (almost-SL when char exceeds socle degree); for socle degree 5, char 3 is explicitly excluded, leaving the F3 Pfaffian regime open. 2406.17943 (Boij-Migliore-Miro-Roig-Nagel): WLP for Sperner<=d+1 in arbitrary codimension but the abstract's sharpness discussion concerns the general bound; the admission record's claim that its operative hypothesis is char 0 throughout vs the abstract is immaterial here because the paper states no F3 non-CI Pfaffian resolution/Jordan datum at this Hilbert function either way. 1811.02072 (Costa-Gondim): mixed-Hessian determination of Jordan types via dual generators, no Pfaffian presentation and no char-3 Pfaffian-vs-CI separation at this function. 2406.06322 (Abdallah-Altafi-Iarrobino-Yameogo): complete JDT only for almost-constant T=(1,3,s^k,3,1) with s=3,4,5 in characteristic zero (s=6 only delimited); H=(1,3,5,5,3,1) is not of that almost-constant form, and the paper's own Example 2.8 discusses H=(1,3,5,5,3,1) only as a rank-matrix O-sequence obstruction example, never exhibiting a non-CI Pfaffian model or Jordan separation there. The resolution difference 1-5-5-1 vs 1-3-3-1 is a routine BE consequence once existence is shown, so the novelty resides in the exhibited F3 Pfaffian model at this exact exceptional Hilbert function plus the computed all-26-forms Jordan disjointness — neither found in any checked source.

value.rationale: The result is an extremal/resolution witness at a published characteristic-3 boundary, not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration. It answers the structural question left open by the char-0 Sperner theorems and the CI-only char-3 exception: whether the non-CI Pfaffian locus at the exact exceptional Hilbert function (1,3,5,5,3,1) — which by Buchsbaum-Eisenbud comprises all non-CI cases — shares the CI resolution and Jordan behavior. It shows both differ, and in the strongest finite-field form (all 26 nonzero linear forms, not just generic). The object is a compact citable datum (one 5x5 alternating matrix over F3, five explicit Pfaffians, Betti shifts, seven Jordan partitions with frequencies 2/4/2/10/2/4/2) replayable in ~seconds with stdlib-only code, independently worth finding later as a classification data point for codim-3 Gorenstein geography in positive characteristic. The fallback alone (first certified non-CI Pfaffian at this function with 1-5-5-1 resolution) would already clear the value bar; the full separation exceeds it.
